_comment: COUPLED warehouse perception->control chain for the paper figure. Same 3 deployed nets, same per-op profiled costs, same per-net deadlines (window_duration) as networks_k1_flight_deployed.json, but now with a REAL data-dependency chain: one camera frame is processed by YOLO (obstacle detection), whose output FEEDS the nav net (fused_full), whose command FEEDS mlp_control. A single frame instance per net makes the chain unambiguous (camera-release@t=0 -> control-output). The end-to-end deadline (chain_end_to_end_deadline_ms) is the perception+control budget the avoidance loop must close within. Solve XPU-RT with op-sharding (machine_combination_mode=shard) across CPU_P#0-3 + E-cores; ROS serializes each net on one pinned executor (no per-inference sharding).

chain.deadline_rationale: camera-frame -> actuator command must close within one cycle of a 30 Hz reactive obstacle-avoidance loop (33.3 ms) so the drone acts on fresh perception; beyond this it flies blind for >1 avoidance cycle. The ordering also holds at the tighter nav-period(20)+control-period(10)=30 ms budget (XPU-RT 29.93 ms meets, ROS 35.58 ms misses).
